llm_response.reason: The website danielwellingtons.es closely mimics the popular Daniel Wellington brand (but is not the official site, which is danielwellington.com). This is a hallmark of a fake online shopping scam. The pluralized domain, use of the .es TLD, ambiguous company/privacy info, and lack of presence on public discussion forums all point towards a spoofed site that aims to trick buyers into thinking it is legitimate. This matches scam characteristics such as characteristic #16 (mimics legitimate company), #4 (possibly non-existent company info), #7 (ambiguous privacy info), and #1 (enticement with free shipping).
